text: 4 chicken drumsticks and two wholegrain slices of bread
assumptions: Typical Australian supermarket drumsticks (~120-130 g raw with bone); oven-baked, skin eaten, no added fat; ~75 g edible meat+skin per drumstick (range ~55-95 g). 'Wholegrain' bread taken as AFCD mixed grain bread, standard sandwich slice ~40 g (range ~32-48 g), untoasted, no spread. Wholemeal (F001553) would be ~12 kcal less for the two slices. AFCD kcal = 'Energy with dietary fibre, equated' kJ / 4.184.

components.source: FSANZ AFCD Release 3 (2025), per 100 g: F002648 'Chicken, drumstick, lean flesh, skin & fat, baked, no added fat'
FSANZ AFCD Release 3 (2025), per 100 g: F001621 'Bread, mixed grain'

assumptions: Weight given as cooked; skinless breast, grilled, no added fat. Range covers baked/pan-cooked breast (AFCD baked F002590 = 304 kcal) and USDA roasted breast (FDC 171477, 165 kcal/100 g = 330 kcal). AFCD kcal = 'Energy with dietary fibre, equated' kJ / 4.184.

components.source: FSANZ AFCD Release 3 (2025), per 100 g: F002593 'Chicken, breast, lean flesh, grilled, no added fat'

assumptions: Assumed 300 g is the raw butcher/pack weight (how Australians usually quote steak size), untrimmed, grilled with no added oil; energy computed from raw composition (cooking loss is mostly water). If the user meant 300 g cooked, AFCD grilled untrimmed rump (F000764) gives ~653 kcal; fully trimmed lean raw would give ~323 kcal, so range is wide. AFCD kcal = 'Energy with dietary fibre, equated' kJ / 4.184. Text says raw to remove the raw/cooked ambiguity.

components.source: FSANZ AFCD Release 3 (2025), per 100 g: F000765 'Beef, rump steak, untrimmed, raw'

Lower-fat mince (F000667) would give ~305 kcal for the mince; cup of rice range ~140-200 g. AFCD kcal = 'Energy with dietary fibre, equated' kJ / 4.184.

text: 2 slices of toast with butter and vegemite
assumptions: White sandwich/toast bread, 2 slices x 35 g fresh weight (AU sandwich slice ~30 g in 650 g loaf to ~37 g in 700 g loaf; toast-cut slices larger). Energy = AFCD 'energy with dietary fibre' (or label kJ) / 4.184; carb = available carbohydrate (excludes fibre).
